finalText:
Found it. The engine was rounding twice when stacking coupons — once after the percent discount and once after the flat discount. This created small precision errors that then got amplified by currency conversion, especially with currencies using non-integer rates like GBP (0.78) or CAD (1.35), and even more so with zero-decimal currencies like JPY.

The reference implementation applies all discounts first, then converts and rounds once at the very end. Removed the intermediate rounding in `engine.js` (lines 24 and 27), keeping only the single final round after conversion. All 40 tests pass now.
